child_tool_info.description: Estimate relationships among selected genomes with BV-BRC CodonTree's combined coding-nucleotide and protein family alignments, retaining family membership, partitions, native trees and measured selection statistics.
child_tool_info.instructions: Assign CodonTree the explicit main genome IDs and/or genome groups, selected number_of_genes, bootstraps, max_genomes_missing and max_allowed_dups, and output destination. This AppService operation uses the combined coding-nucleotide and protein path; codon-only, protein-only, Pos3, PLFam and debug/preparation CLI switches are not bound service modes. Leaves represent genomes; preserve each feature-to-family-to-genome association and the dependence between protein and coding-nucleotide representations of the same gene. Keep requested main, requested optional, source-backed group members, actually forwarded optional, returned, eligible, evaluated and final populations distinct. The retained App wrapper writes optional_genome_ids but does not forward its optional input file; a request cannot establish their use. Group paths and final tips do not supply requested membership. Missing family matrix cells are unknown unless an explicit complete population establishes absence. Preserve native paralog exclusions and missing CDS records without claiming optimal selection or validated translation. Current combined output uses aligned FASTA; the retained older example uses relaxed PHYLIP. Acquire the actual matrix, partition file, raw/support/rooted/display trees as separately selected objects, native membership, family-statistics, genome-count and analysis-statistics tables and available RAxML 8 logs. Declare the exact table dialect, including the known missing tab in the current family-statistics header. Per-family final alignments, bootstrap replicate forests and historical per-sequence frequency data are not guaranteed normal service outputs. Final alignment statistics do not reconstruct missing pre-trim/evaluated populations. The four global codon/protein partitions do not identify family block boundaries. Mixed-model joint branch lengths are not per-nucleotide divergence or time. Use the existing launch episode and its selected API child for the unchanged native assignment. The invocation schema also includes the existing results commission; its version identifies which assignment is supplied. api.bvbrc_appservice.prepare validates the selected application definition, original native parameters, inputs and output destination without submitting. Select workspace_metadata, workspace_create and upload separately when input preparation or transfer is needed. submit performs the selected AppService.start_app2 call and retains the actual request, response and original task identity. Use the resource-generic monitoring episode and selected status/query_tasks observations plus task_info stdout or stderr when relevant; retain native states, observation times and actual logs. Logs and process liveness do not prove productive execution, completion or throughput. Choose further observations within the episode; no polling cadence or automatic retry is supplied. Results can select task_info, workspace_metadata, list_outputs, download_capability and download to obtain the actual original-task artifacts. Retain task, Workspace path/UUID, manifest/association evidence and complete acquired bytes. A directory entry, HTML report or filename suffix does not prove format, task production or immutable producer-byte identity. Transfer/status/preparation facts receive no fabricated annotation-confidence score. This API route does not claim local scientific execution, live authentication, deployment or a successfully executed service job. Before results acquisition, select exact semantic roles and analysis-local artifact slots, reader format/dialect, original source-order tree indices, populations, calculation parameters and requested typed fields. The scientific mode is stored at adapter.parameters.analyses[].analysis.mode. A role alone is not proof of which locus/analysis produced an artifact. Pass exact source-backed input/member, row/tip, feature/family/genome, function and taxon joins through the originally selected scientific_inputs and supplied_metadata. Already acquired supplemental native documents also need their exact original supplied_contents byte bindings; nested JSON source identifiers do not authenticate them. The bound provider adapter uses the declared Newick, aligned FASTA, relaxed PHYLIP, RAxML partition, phyloXML, RAxML 8 log and, for CodonTree, native-table readers. Separate provider extractors populate the numerical sheet, and calculate_gene_tree or calculate_codon_tree computes the explicit selected components without network, job or model calls. Use the provider requested_form_schema finite selectors for numerical counts, gap/conservation/site measurements, branch/support rows, function composition, relationship comparisons and, for CodonTree, family measurements/membership; request requirements and qualifications when the receiver needs them. Known branch units, support methods, bootstrap denominators and original residue maps require actual evidence. Missing, not measured, failed, truncated, incompatible and measured zero remain distinct. Preserve valid independent partial data and signed native values. Branch support and native conservation/selection statistics are not calibrated annotation probabilities. Retain every originally selected analysis, complete native artifact, populated sheet, parameter set and component set internally. Recalculate saved sheets with explicit changed parameters without reacquiring data or rerunning analysis; historical observations remain unchanged. Return only the parent's originally requested typed numerical fields through the existing bvbrc_phylogeny return sources, with no model-composed restatement or automatic widening of that form.
